title: 微软AI故事仍在被发现，高盛看好上行空间
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: As your growth at that level, it seems to be the main metric, so let's start there.
segments.zh: 既然增长是主要指标，我们就从那里开始。

segments.en: What do we actually learn about that ROI through the Azure number?
segments.zh: 通过Azure数据，我们实际能了解到哪些关于ROI的信息？

segments.en: Hi, good morning. It's interesting because from the outside in, we can certainly see component pricing moving higher, we can see capex announcements,
segments.zh: 早上好。有趣的是，从外部看，我们确实看到组件价格上涨、资本支出公告和内存价格变化。

segments.en: we can see memory pricing. But we don't always have perfect visibility into the other side of that equation, which is Microsoft's ability to monetize the ROI on the other end in the Azure
segments.zh: 但我们并不总能清楚看到等式的另一面，即微软在Azure业务中变现ROI的能力。

segments.en: business. And there are a couple of really interesting dynamics this quarter, wherein you take something like GitHub, for example, GitHub is now moved to being able to be
segments.zh: 本季度有几个非常有趣的动态，比如GitHub现在可以按用量向高级用户收费。

segments.en: monetized in a consumption basis for power users such that as customers get more value out of it, well, Microsoft directly gets more monetization out of it. And so I think you're seeing more
segments.zh: 客户从GitHub获得更多价值，微软也直接获得更多收入。我认为微软在变现方面有更多手段，但可能不像以前那么明显。

segments.en: breadcrumbs around Microsoft's ability to pull varying levers on the monetization side, but perhaps to not nearly as obvious before.
segments.zh: Gabriella，我觉得有趣的是回顾Alphabet，看看Google分享了Gemini的哪些非财务指标，然后微软又是如何做的？

segments.en: Gabriella, what I found interesting was to look back at Alphabet and say what were the non-financial metrics that Google shared about Gemini? And then how did Microsoft kind of do the same?
segments.zh: Copilot季度末安装量达3000万，高于3月季度的2000万，这对你判断微软AI的吸引力有用吗？

segments.en: So, co-pilot, 30 million installed seats at the end of the quarter, up from 20 million at the March quarter, is that useful information to you for how Microsoft's offering an AI is gaming traction?
segments.zh: 那么，Copilot 在季度末拥有3000万安装席位，高于3月季度的2000万，这对您了解微软AI产品的市场接受度是否有帮助？
